verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a SaaS scheduling product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out or privacy controls. The "no annoying ads" line on meeting polls is about ads, not tracking opt-out, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
